name: Fire
description: Doom-style rising fire built from advected fBm, drawn as three ridges at three depths under lit smoke — a near wall of flame against the lens, a middle front and a far one burning on the horizon. Flares up on the kick.

height.description: How far the nearest front reaches up the frame. The others are scaled down from it.

stack.description: How far apart the three fuel lines sit. 0 stacks them all on the bottom edge and the depth collapses.
